Create account mandates in the platform

params.name: clientId
params.description:
A Receive system identifier that will be assigned automatically.
It will be used for situations like Support related interventions or data segmentation.

params.name: triggerName
params.description: This is name of Custom Trigger that should be triggered when this API is called.

params.name: sequential
params.description: The request body items are executed one after another one

params.name: async
params.description: The request is added to the queue without expecting the response

params.name: minorVersion
params.description: Optional minor version identifier for message versioning. This value is passed as additional metadata with emitted messages.
